name: unpolish-ai-writing
description: Removes signs of AI-generated writing, and optionally adds sparse typing errors informed by researched human error patterns.

interface.shortDescription: Strip AI writing tells, optional sparse typos
interface.longDescription: Removes common AI writing tells (assistant residue, Not-X-it's-Y pivots, rule of three, em-dash habit, filler vocabulary) from a draft. Optionally adds sparse typing errors: the count is drawn from a Poisson rate scaled to word count and the type from a weighted mix based on human typing-error research, seeded by a hash of the text.
